summary: Genius Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 5, 2026, announcing an investor call and releasing materials for its previously disclosed AGI Infinity Portfolio strategy. The filing describes a board-approved plan to deploy up to $100 million initially, targeting $800 million over five years into AGI-related companies. No specific transaction terms, prices, premiums, or other deal mechanics are provided. The filing is a routine update of a strategic initiative, not an actionable special situation event like an acquisition or tender offer. The filing does not trigger classification as a special situation.
